gradingNote.label: NOTE ON THE ESTIMATED VALUE IF GRADED
gradingNote.headline: ILLUSTRATIVE INFORMATION ONLY. THIS IS NOT AN APPRAISAL OF THIS CARD.
gradingNote.p1: The PSA 10 / PSA 9 figures are market reference data for that card model as graded by third parties. They are shown to illustrate how the market behaves — nothing more.
gradingNote.p2: They do NOT reflect or evaluate the condition of the card you are buying. We have not inspected, measured or pre-screened this specific copy for grading purposes — not its centering, not its surface, not its edges, not its corners — and we offer no opinion on what grade it would receive. We sell this card as raw (ungraded) Near Mint under our own condition standard, which is a different thing from a PSA grade.
gradingNote.p3: We guarantee no grade whatsoever. The grade is determined by PSA, independently and under its own criteria. The result may be far below what is illustrated here, and the card may not even be eligible for grading. Grading is a gamble and the risk is entirely yours.
gradingNote.p4: This is not an offer, not a price guarantee, and not a buy-back commitment by TCG HUNT. If you send the card in for grading and the result is not what you hoped for, there is no refund, compensation or return on that basis (our final-sale policy applies).
gradingNote.p5: TCG HUNT does not grade cards and does not broker grading services. PSA fees, international shipping, return shipping to Mexico, insurance and turnaround times are entirely on you.
gradingNote.p6: Market prices change every day and this estimate may become outdated at any time.

legal.title: Terms & policy
legal.intro: These terms apply to every purchase and to card custody at TCG HUNT.
legal.scopeNote: The policy applies to every product type: raw, sealed and graded cards.
legal.refundBody: All sales are final. Once you buy a card, the sale is not eligible for a refund or cancellation.
legal.platformErrorBody: If the problem is an error on our side —for example, a duplicate charge or a purchase with no real inventory backing it— we always refund you, with no need to open a dispute.
legal.disputeBody: Another exception is receiving a damaged or wrong card. In that case you may open a condition dispute within 7 calendar days, counted from shipment delivery. Evidence is sent by email to our support inbox (no photo upload in the app).
legal.disputeWindowNote: The 7-day window starts on the day the shipment is delivered, not on the purchase or payment date.
legal.disputeOutcome: If the dispute is upheld, we compensate you for the damage or error and you keep the card: there is no product return.
legal.questionsBody: For any clarification about these terms, email us at soporte@tcghunt.mx.

dispute.evidenceBody: Email your photos and evidence to our support inbox, citing your order or dispute number. No photo upload in the app.

catalog.title: Catalog sync (pokemontcg.io)
catalog.subtitle: Import sets and cards from the reference catalog. Default sets 2024+; backfill older collections in batches.
catalog.setsEmpty: No sets yet. Use "Import new sets" (Catalog group) as the first step.
catalog.busyReason: Wait for the running sweep to finish.
catalog.syncAllHint: "Import new sets" brings newly released sets that aren't imported yet (light operation); the system also does this automatically twice a day. "Re-sync everything (force)" reprocesses the ENTIRE catalog: metadata, cards and variants/finishes (heavy operation). It does NOT repopulate prices: use "Update prices now" or the per-set "Full sync" for that.
catalog.fullSyncAria: Full sync of {name}: cards, variants and prices
catalog.fullSyncHint: Per set: "Import"/"Re-sync" only brings metadata and cards (it doesn't refresh variants or touch prices). "Full sync" chains two phases: first the set's cards + variants/finishes, then the prices for that entire set.
catalog.fullSyncPhaseCatalog: Full sync of {name} — phase 1/2: syncing cards and variants…
catalog.fullSyncPhasePrices: Full sync of {name} — cards and variants done · phase 2/2: queueing the set's prices…
catalog.fullSyncDone: Full sync of {name}: cards and variants updated; set prices queued (running in the background — progress shows in the "Update prices" bar).
catalog.fullSyncPricesAlreadyRunning: Full sync of {name}: cards and variants updated, but a price sweep was already running and this set's prices were NOT queued. Once it finishes, trigger "Update prices now" or repeat the full sync.
catalog.fullSyncCatalogError: Full sync of {name}: the cards/variants phase failed; no prices were queued.
catalog.fullSyncPricesError: Full sync of {name}: cards and variants updated, but queueing prices failed. Retry with "Update prices now".
catalog.refreshVariantsAria: Refresh variants and prices for {name} using TCGCSV only
catalog.refreshVariantsHint: "Variants + prices (TCGCSV only)" refreshes an ALREADY imported set's variants/finishes and prices using TCGCSV alone: it does NOT re-import cards and does NOT depend on pokemontcg.io. Use it to fix a set's missing variants or prices when pokemontcg.io is unavailable.
catalog.refreshVariantsNeedsImport: Import the set first (it must exist in the database).
catalog.refreshVariantsRunning: Refreshing {name}'s variants and prices from TCGCSV… it does not re-import cards or use pokemontcg.io. This may take a few seconds.
catalog.refreshVariantsSummary: {cards} card(s) processed · {products} product(s)/variant(s) updated · {prices} price(s) updated.
catalog.refreshVariantsPartial: {name}'s variants + prices refreshed from TCGCSV (partial result).
catalog.refreshVariantsUnreachable: TCGCSV did not respond fully, so the refresh is partial; retry when TCGCSV is available.

minUpside.hint: What must be left for the buyer above the total cost (card + grading) for the card to be worth promoting. Always evaluated on the PSA 9 estimate, the realistic scenario.

reason.NO_PSA9: The PSA 9 estimate is missing: without it there is no promotion, even though the card page does show the PSA 10.
reason.STALE: The figure is older than the freshness window.
reason.NO_COST_TIER: No cost tier covers that value: with no tier, no card is featured.
reason.BELOW_MIN_UPSIDE: The upside over the PSA 9 does not reach the required minimum.
reason.SLAB_PUBLISHED: There is a published slab of that grade: that row is real money, not an estimate.
reason.NOT_ABOVE_RAW: The PSA 10 does not exceed the raw price. This is usually a dollar amount captured as pesos.
reason.ABOVE_MAX_MULTIPLE: The PSA 10 exceeds the maximum multiple over the raw price. This is usually one zero too many.
reason.GRADE_ORDER_INVERTED: The PSA 9 is worth more than the PSA 10: the two rows look swapped.

gradedEstimateReview.subtitle: When an estimated figure is not believable against the card's price, it is NOT hidden on the card page —we report what we have— and in exchange it shows up here so somebody can fix it. Without this list we would publish the odd number and lose the signal as well.

gradedEstimateReview.includeSlabPublishedHint: Left out of the default list on purpose: these are not wrong figures —they are rows that already are the real price of a piece— and mixing them in would drown out the signal of the incoherent ones.
gradedEstimateReview.includeStaleHint: An expired figure existed and lapsed: it stopped showing in the store, but it is still in the table. That is the case this list exists to surface. Out of the default for the same reason as published slabs: it is not an incoherent figure and it would drown out the signal.

gradedEstimateReview.howToFix: There is no «mark as reviewed» (it would require storing new state and is out of scope). Fix it by re-capturing the estimate above, or by removing the figure with «Remove PSA…» in its row. If the figure is automatic and expired, the remedy is not this card: check the ingest.

gradedEstimateReview.deleteBlockedBody: When a published slab of that grade exists, that row is no longer an estimate: it is the market reference of a physical piece that is on sale. Deleting it would leave that piece with no price (it would fall to price-pending and be unpublished). The remedy is not removing, it is repricing the piece in Inventory › Graded with «Set value» (intent «market»).

gradedEstimateReview.deleteConfirmAllRows: ALL captures of that grade for this card are deleted, not just the current one: history included. If only the latest were removed, the previous one would surface and the figure would come back on its own.
gradedEstimateReview.deleteConfirmScope: It does not touch sale prices, does not unpublish any piece and does not create pending prices: it removes an informational figure and nothing else.
gradedEstimateReview.deleteConfirmAudit: Super-admin only · logged with what was there. Undoing it means capturing the figure again by hand.
gradedEstimateReview.deleteSlabPublishedNote: This is the guard doing its job, not a failure: insisting on deleting is not the way. Reprice the piece in Inventory › Graded with «Set value» (intent «market»), which is a deliberate, audited money action.

curve.title: Price curve
curve.lead: Price comes only from each card's market value. Rarity and finish no longer take part in the math. Each curve is a list of points you define: between two points the value is interpolated in a straight line; before the first and after the last it stays flat. Changes take effect without republishing and are logged.
curve.footerNote: On save, the catalog is repriced on the next calculation · manual prices (overrides) are left untouched · it is logged.

labels.gradingHookEnabled: Grading hook — publishes and fetches data

gradingHook.note: A single switch governs the hook: on, the storefront publishes the estimated figures and the daily sweep fetches them from a paid provider; off, it publishes none and updates none. Grading cost tiers, minimum upside, freshness and the per-run card cap are edited in M2 · Catalog and pricing, along with the review list — the tool for a single figure. That cap limits how many of your cards the sweep looks at, not how many the provider bills you for.
gradingHook.onTitle: On: publishes figures and spends credits
gradingHook.on: It publishes. With this dial on, the storefront shows estimated PSA 10 / PSA 9 figures for ungraded cards, with its disclaimer (approved by the owner; not reviewed by a lawyer): it is a commercial claim by the store. And it spends. The same dial lets the daily sweep ask a paid provider for those figures and write estimated prices. How much it spends has not been measured yet. What we do know is the scope: the sweep looks at up to {maxCards, number} of your cards per run, {runs} runs a day (that cap is edited in M2 · Catalog and pricing). What we do not know is how the provider bills: if it charges per request, the ceiling is {credits, number} credits a day ({maxCards, number} × {perCard} × {runs}); if it charges per returned card, each request asks for the whole set, the sweep pays for every card in each set it touches, and the bill can be several times that figure. The first run measures it; until then, {credits, number} is a ceiling under an assumption, not a budget. Credits spent are not recovered by turning it off. It changes no sale price, valuation or quote: it changes what the store claims — and what it costs.
gradingHook.onMeasured: It publishes. With this dial on, the storefront shows estimated PSA 10 / PSA 9 figures for ungraded cards, with its disclaimer (approved by the owner; not reviewed by a lawyer): it is a commercial claim by the store. And it spends. The same dial lets the daily sweep ask a paid provider for those figures and write estimated prices. How much it spends has been measured. The sweep looks at up to {maxCards, number} of your cards per run, {runs} runs a day, and the run measured on {measuredOn} spent at a rate of {credits, number} credits a day. That is a measurement, not an assumption: if the cap, the inventory or the provider changes, it gets measured again. Credits spent are not recovered by turning it off. It changes no sale price, valuation or quote: it changes what the store claims — and what it costs.
gradingHook.onNoFigures: It publishes. With this dial on, the storefront shows estimated PSA 10 / PSA 9 figures for ungraded cards, with its disclaimer (approved by the owner; not reviewed by a lawyer): it is a commercial claim by the store. And it spends. The same dial lets the daily sweep ask a paid provider for those figures and write estimated prices. How much it spends has not been measured yet. It consumes credits on every run. The cap you set in M2 · Catalog and pricing limits how many of your cards the sweep looks at, not how many the provider bills you for: each request asks for the whole set. What it really costs is measured by the first run. Credits spent are not recovered by turning it off. It changes no sale price, valuation or quote: it changes what the store claims — and what it costs.
gradingHook.audit: Super-admin only · recorded in the audit log.
gradingHook.offTitle: Turning it off also stops updating
gradingHook.off: It stops both at once. While off, the storefront shows no estimated figure and the sweep neither requests nor writes any: not a credit is spent, and automatic data stops being refreshed. For one specific figure, this is not the remedy. A wrong figure is deleted from the review list; if what’s excessive is the promotion, raise the minimum upside in M2 and the card page keeps informing. Turn it off when the doubt is systemic: the provider changed, or the figures are no longer trustworthy. When you turn it back on, the next run restores the automatic figures; if you’re in a hurry, “Refresh prices now” in M2.

error.CONFLICT: There was a conflict with the current state.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests, try again later.
error.PRICE_PENDING: This card has a pending price and can't be purchased yet.
error.ITEM_UNAVAILABLE: This card is no longer available.
error.ITEM_NOT_SETTLED: You can only withdraw settled cards.
error.ADDRESS_NOT_MX: We only ship to addresses within Mexico.
error.ITEM_IN_ANOTHER_SHIPMENT: This card is already in another shipment.
error.BUYLIST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: You exceed the allowed buylist cap.
error.INE_REQUIRED: You need to upload your INE to continue.
error.CLABE_NOT_OWN_NAME: The CLABE must be in your name.
error.FINISH_NOT_AVAILABLE: That finish isn't available for this card.
error.PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND: That product no longer exists in the catalog.
error.PRODUCT_CARD_MISMATCH: That product doesn't belong to this card.
error.ITEM_NOT_PUBLISHABLE: This piece can't be published in its current status.
error.MONEY_OUT_FORBIDDEN: Only the super-admin can execute money-out actions.
error.REQUEST_HAS_NON_REJECTED_ITEMS: Cannot close: some items are not rejected yet. Reject every item in the request before closing it.
error.NOT_RAW: Only raw cards can be disputed.
error.GOOGLE_TOKEN_INVALID: We couldn't validate your Google sign-in. Please try again.
error.GOOGLE_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED: Your Google email isn't verified; use another method or verify your email.
error.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Verify your email to complete this action.
error.EMAIL_VERIFY_TOKEN_INVALID: The verification link is invalid or expired.
error.RESET_TOKEN_INVALID: The reset link is invalid or expired.
error.APPROVED_PRICE_CAP_EXCEEDED: The approved price exceeds the allowed cap for this item (quoted × 2 or AML cap).
error.ITEM_NOT_APPROVED: Only an approved item can be converted to inventory.
error.CLABE_UNAVAILABLE: No CLABE available for this request (no snapshot and no KYC record).
error.ITEM_NOT_ADJUSTABLE: This piece can't be adjusted in its current status.
error.ALREADY_AUTHENTICATED: You already have a session: continue with your account.
error.PAYMENT_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: We couldn't reach the payment processor. Try again in a few minutes.
error.BOUNTY_PRICE_REQUIRED: A bounty needs an explicit price.
error.BOUNTY_BELOW_RULE: A bounty must pay more than the current rate ({suggested}). At the same amount it would not be an offer.
error.SET_NOT_IMPORTED: That set is not imported yet; import it before refreshing its variants.
error.UPSTREAM_ERROR: TCGCSV is unavailable right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
error.SEALED_PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND: That sealed product no longer exists or is inactive; sync the catalog again.
error.MANUAL_MARKET_NOT_ALLOWED: This presentation already has a market price; the manual price only applies when there is no market.
error.CURVE_EMPTY: The curve has no points left: nothing was saved.
error.DUPLICATE_BREAKPOINT: Two points share the same market: nothing was saved.
error.SALE_BELOW_MARKET: A point would sell below market: nothing was saved.
error.SALE_CURVE_NOT_MONOTONIC: The sale curve drops as market goes up: nothing was saved.
error.BUY_CURVE_NOT_MONOTONIC: The buy curve would pay less as market goes up: nothing was saved.
error.BUY_ABOVE_SALE: Buying catches up with selling somewhere: nothing was saved.
error.BIN_ABOVE_FLOOR: The buy minimum reaches the sale floor: nothing was saved.
error.ROUNDING_LADDER_INVALID: The rounding ladder is invalid: nothing was saved.
error.GRADING_TIERS_EMPTY: The tier table cannot be left empty: with no tier, no card is promoted.
error.GRADING_TIERS_NOT_CONTIGUOUS: Tiers must cover the whole range with no gaps or overlaps, starting at MX$0: check the end of each tier.
error.GRADING_TIERS_NOT_OPEN_ENDED: The last tier must be open-ended («and above») and the only one without an end, so that no expensive card is left without a tier.
error.GRADED_INTENT_REQUIRED: You must declare what you are setting on a graded card: the MARKET PRICE of a published slab (real money) or the ESTIMATED VALUE if it were graded (an illustrative figure). Nothing was saved.
error.GRADED_ESTIMATE_SLAB_PUBLISHED: This card already has a published piece of that grade. That price is real money, not an estimate; to change it, edit the piece price in Inventory › Graded.
error.GRADED_ESTIMATE_SLAB_PUBLISHED_WITH_DETA: This card already has {count, plural, one {one published {grade} piece} other {# published {grade} pieces}}. That price is real money, not an estimate; to change it, edit the piece price in Inventory › Graded.
error.GRADING_SORT_REQUIRES_FILTER: That sort order only exists for the showcase of cards worth grading; without that filter it cannot be applied.
error.GRADED_CONFIG_INVALID: A threshold in the hook configuration is corrupt, so nothing is evaluated: a review list computed against a garbage threshold is worse than no list. Fix the configuration above and retry.
